stall.truth_definition: stall = the wound closes less than 10% more after the cut-off (area at the last frame >= 90% of the area at the cut-off)

schedule.call: unlikely to reach 90% closure by 19 h
schedule.evidence: on held-out WHAD wounds such early calls were right 91% of the time (always saying no: 75%)

output.start: forecast.band_start(0.25, seed): a synthetic band, not this wound's own mask
output.fit_error_definition: RMSE of area_norm (simulated mean of 3 seeds vs observed) at the observed frames after 0 h up to the check; lower is a better fit

hypotheses.name: partial_stall
hypotheses.description: cells in the lower half of the field never start a move

hypotheses.name: normal
hypotheses.description: default start and preset migration time

hypotheses.name: edge_damage
hypotheses.description: ragged, wider start wound (cells within 2 sites of the edge lost with probability 0.6)

hypotheses.name: low_density
hypotheses.description: 25% of sheet cells missing at the start (weakly identifiable: holes refill)
